title: Botswana's Okavango Delta floods in the dry season
body: The Okavango River spreads across an inland delta in Botswana instead of reaching the sea. Floodwater arrives during Botswana's dry season, partly because it has travelled downstream from rains farther north.
takeaway: For local wildlife, the calendar of water can differ from the calendar of rain.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Okavango Delta (2014)
visual: a branching network of flooded channels spreading into the dry Kalahari

title: About 94% of Zealandia lies underwater
body: In 2017 geologists described Zealandia as a 4.9 million square kilometre region of continental crust in the southwest Pacific. New Zealand and New Caledonia are among the parts that rise above sea level.
takeaway: A map of coastlines can hide the outlines of an entire region of continental crust.
visual: a relief view of New Zealand with a broad submerged plateau beneath the surrounding sea
